title: Deadlock
provenance: DXMT changelog v0.73 (github.com/3Shain/dxmt/releases) playX18 (upstream#243, 2026-09-28): rated 4, playable with minor issues, Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.0, DXMT, a full standard match played; engine and KLYC-Box version not stated.
notes: MetalFX temporal scaler output fixed A report has a full standard match playable on DXMT on an M5 Pro, with two costs: about ten minutes of shader compilation before the game stops stuttering, and audio crackle, which that player fixed by setting the Mac's output to 88.2 kHz in Audio MIDI Setup.

anticheat.note: anti-cheat present; Linux/Proton support does not extend to macOS — userspace path works for some titles

knownIssues.symptom: Audio crackles (reported in the main hub on an M5 MacBook Air, upstream#187, and in matches on an M5 Pro, upstream#243).
knownIssues.cause: not established. 48 kHz output changed nothing for the first reporter, and the crackle does not follow the frame time, so it sits in the audio path rather than a stall.
knownIssues.fix: reported working by one player, not verified here: set the Mac's output to 88.2 kHz in Audio MIDI Setup (Applications, Utilities), then restart the game.

knownIssues.symptom: Stutter for the first minutes of a match (reported on an M5 Pro, DXMT).
knownIssues.fix: none needed, it settles after about ten minutes.
